headers.name: actual_ordered_block_finite_receiver
headers.header:
theorem actual_ordered_block_finite_receiver
    (face : TaxonOuterFace D N.leaf)
    (hnt : ∃ u v : BlobVertex N.graph b, u≠v) :
    ∃ (code : N.BlobPort b ↪ Nat) (C : Set Plane) (f : ℝ → Plane) (θ : (M).OpenedTip → ℝ) (xs : List (M).OpenedTip)
      (k : Nat) (base : List Nat) (dup : Nat → Bool)
      (s : BinarySyntax (M).OpenedHybridVertex) (label : (M).OpenedHybridVertex → Nat) (T : Tree),
      IsJordanCurve C ∧
      Graph.face (graph (blobCurves D b)) (curve (blobCurves D b))
        (coordinates face.outside)=outside C ∧
      IsLoop f ∧ f '' unitInterval=C ∧
      (∀ t, θ t∈Ico (0:ℝ) 1 ∧ f (θ t)=tipPoint N D b hg hb t) ∧
      Function.Injective θ ∧ xs.Nodup ∧ (∀ t, t∈xs) ∧
      xs.Pairwise (fun a c => θ a≤θ c) ∧
      (∀ (k : (M).OpenedHybridEdge) (a c d e : (M).OpenedTip),
        (OG).OrientedQuartet k ((M).openedTipVertex a) ((M).openedTipVertex c)
          ((M).openedTipVertex d) ((M).openedTipVertex e) →
        ¬((θ a<θ d ∧ θ d<θ c ∧ θ c<θ e) ∨
          (θ d<θ a ∧ θ a<θ e ∧ θ e<θ c))) ∧
      (∀ a c : (M).OpenedTip, θ a<θ c →
        (M).openedTipLabel hl a=(M).openedTipLabel hl c →
        (∀ w, ¬(θ a<θ w ∧ θ w<θ c)) ∨
          (∀ w, ¬(θ w<θ a ∨ θ c<θ w))) ∧
      (∀ a c : (M).OpenedTip, a≠c →
        (M).openedTipLabel hl a=(M).openedTipLabel hl c →
        Nanuq.Restriction.CyclicGap (xs.map (fun t => code ((M).openedTipLabel hl t)))
          (code ((M).openedTipLabel hl a)) (code ((M).openedTipLabel hl a))) ∧
      k≤1 ∧ base.Nodup ∧
      (xs.rotate k).map (fun t => code ((M).openedTipLabel hl t))=Nanuq.Restriction.blocks base dup ∧
      s.frontier=xs.map (M).openedTipVertex ∧
      (∀ (lab : (M).OpenedHybridVertex → Nat) a b c d,
        LabelledQuartet (OG) lab a b c d ↔ (encode lab s).Witness [] a b c d) ∧
      (∀ t, label ((M).openedTipVertex t)=code ((M).openedTipLabel hl t)) ∧
      T.size=(Nanuq.Restriction.blocks base dup).length-1 ∧
      (∀ (q : Quartet) (r a b c d : Nat), q.parts r=(a,b,c,d) → a≠b → c≠d →
        (LabelledQuartet (OG) label a b c d ↔
          ∃ e∈T.internalIntervals 1,
            edgeWitness (Nanuq.Restriction.blocks base dup) e.1 e.2 q r=true))

headers.name: anchored_frontier_convex
headers.header:
theorem anchored_frontier_convex (v anchor : V) (rest : BinarySyntax V)
    (rank : V → R) (code : V → Nat)
    (hnd : (.fork v (.tip anchor) rest : BinarySyntax V).frontier.Nodup)
    (hfirst : ∀ x∈(.fork v (.tip anchor) rest : BinarySyntax V).frontier,
      x≠anchor → rank anchor<rank x)
    (hno : ∀ a c d e,
      a∈(.fork v (.tip anchor) rest : BinarySyntax V).frontier →
      c∈(.fork v (.tip anchor) rest : BinarySyntax V).frontier →
      d∈(.fork v (.tip anchor) rest : BinarySyntax V).frontier →
      e∈(.fork v (.tip anchor) rest : BinarySyntax V).frontier →
      (encode code (.fork v (.tip anchor) rest)).Witness [] (code a) (code c) (code d) (code e) →
      ¬((rank a<rank d ∧ rank d<rank c ∧ rank c<rank e) ∨
        (rank d<rank a ∧ rank a<rank e ∧ rank e<rank c)))
    {u : BinarySyntax V} {out : List V} (hu : Context rest u out) :
    ∀ a∈u.frontier, ∀ c∈u.frontier,
      ∀ b∈(.fork v (.tip anchor) rest : BinarySyntax V).frontier,
        rank a<rank b → rank b<rank c → b∈u.frontier

headers.name: convex_sides_separated
headers.header:
theorem convex_sides_separated (ambient l r : List V) (rank : V → R)
    (hl : ∀ x∈l, x∈ambient) (hr : ∀ x∈r, x∈ambient)
    (hi : ∀ a∈ambient, ∀ b∈ambient, rank a=rank b → a=b)
    (hd : ∀ x∈l, x∉r) (hnl : l≠[]) (hnr : r≠[])
    (hcl : RankConvex ambient rank l) (hcr : RankConvex ambient rank r) :
    (∀ a∈l, ∀ c∈r, rank a<rank c) ∨
      (∀ c∈r, ∀ a∈l, rank c<rank a)

headers.name: occurrence_order_receiver
headers.header:
theorem occurrence_order_receiver (t : BinarySyntax V) (xs : List V)
    (rank : V → R) (code : V → Nat)
    (hp : t.frontier.Perm xs) (hnd : xs.Nodup) (hs : 2≤xs.length)
    (hsort : xs.Pairwise (fun a b => rank a<rank b))
    (hi : ∀ a∈xs, ∀ b∈xs, rank a=rank b → a=b)
    (hno : ∀ a c d e, a∈xs → c∈xs → d∈xs → e∈xs →
      (encode code t).Witness [] (code a) (code c) (code d) (code e) →
      ¬((rank a<rank d ∧ rank d<rank c ∧ rank c<rank e) ∨
        (rank d<rank a ∧ rank a<rank e ∧ rank e<rank c))) :
    ∃ s : BinarySyntax V, s.frontier=xs ∧
      ∀ (label : V → Nat) a b c d,
        (encode label s).Witness [] a b c d ↔ (encode label t).Witness [] a b c d

headers.name: witness_fork_right_congr
headers.header:
theorem witness_fork_right_congr (l r r' : LTree)
    (hleaves : ∀ x, x∈r.leaves ↔ x∈r'.leaves)
    (hw : ∀ out a b c d, r.Witness out a b c d ↔ r'.Witness out a b c d)
    (out : List Nat) (a b c d : Nat) :
    (LTree.fork l r).Witness out a b c d ↔
      (LTree.fork l r').Witness out a b c d

headers.name: order_convex_syntax
headers.header:
theorem order_convex_syntax (ambient : List V) (rank : V → R)
    (hi : ∀ a∈ambient, ∀ b∈ambient, rank a=rank b → a=b)
    (t : BinarySyntax V)
    (hall : ∀ x∈t.frontier, x∈ambient) (hnd : t.frontier.Nodup)
    (hconv : ∀ u out, Context t u out → RankConvex ambient rank u.frontier) :
    ∃ s : BinarySyntax V, s.frontier.Perm t.frontier ∧
      s.frontier.Pairwise (fun a b => rank a<rank b) ∧
      ∀ (label : V → Nat) out a b c d,
        (encode label s).Witness out a b c d ↔ (encode label t).Witness out a b c d

headers.name: rooted_tree_order_receiver
headers.header:
theorem rooted_tree_order_receiver (N : RootedBinary V E X)
    (hui : Function.Injective N.graph.target)
    (xs : List X) (θ : X → ℝ) (hnd : xs.Nodup) (hall : ∀ x, x∈xs)
    (hθ : Function.Injective θ) (horder : xs.Pairwise (fun a b => θ a≤θ b))
    (hcuts : ∀ (e : E) (a c d f : X),
      N.graph.OrientedQuartet e (N.leaf a) (N.leaf c) (N.leaf d) (N.leaf f) →
      ¬((θ a<θ d ∧ θ d<θ c ∧ θ c<θ f) ∨
        (θ d<θ a ∧ θ a<θ f ∧ θ f<θ c))) :
    ∃ s : BinarySyntax V, s.frontier=xs.map N.leaf ∧
      ∀ (label : V → Nat) a b c d,
        LabelledQuartet N.graph label a b c d ↔ (encode label s).Witness [] a b c d

headers.name: rotate_whole_leaves
headers.header:
theorem rotate_whole_leaves (t : LTree) (hsize : 2≤t.leaves.length) :
    ∃ u : LTree, u.leaves=t.leaves.rotate 1 ∧
      ∀ a b c d, u.Witness [] a b c d ↔ t.Witness [] a b c d

headers.name: rotated_finite_receiver
headers.header:
theorem rotated_finite_receiver (t : LTree) (hsize : 2≤t.leaves.length)
    (k : Nat) (hk : k≤1) :
    ∃ T : Tree, T.size=(t.leaves.rotate k).length-1 ∧
      ∀ (q : Quartet) (r a b c d : Nat), q.parts r=(a,b,c,d) → a≠b → c≠d →
        (t.Witness [] a b c d ↔
          ∃ e∈T.internalIntervals 1, edgeWitness (t.leaves.rotate k) e.1 e.2 q r=true)

headers.name: focus_left
headers.header:
theorem focus_left (l : BinarySyntax V) (a : V) (ha : a∈l.frontier)
    (root : V) (r : BinarySyntax V) :
    ∃ v rest, (.fork v (.tip a) rest : BinarySyntax V).frontier.Perm
        (.fork root l r).frontier ∧
      ∀ (label : V → Nat) i j k m,
        (encode label (.fork v (.tip a) rest)).Witness [] i j k m ↔
          (encode label (.fork root l r)).Witness [] i j k m

headers.name: focus_occurrence
headers.header:
theorem focus_occurrence (t : BinarySyntax V) (a : V) (ha : a∈t.frontier)
    (hsize : 2≤t.frontier.length) :
    ∃ v rest, (.fork v (.tip a) rest : BinarySyntax V).frontier.Perm t.frontier ∧
      ∀ (label : V → Nat) i j k m,
        (encode label (.fork v (.tip a) rest)).Witness [] i j k m ↔
          (encode label t).Witness [] i j k m
